aiw_inference.definition: Running a trained model to produce one answer. Cheap and fast compared with training, and it is what happens when you press send.
aiw_inference.example: Training cost a fortune; inference is what you pay for every time you use it.

dpn_commitment_consistency.definition: The pressure to act in line with what you have already agreed or done.
dpn_commitment_consistency.example: He had approved the budget, so the second approval came easier.

war_attrition.definition: The wearing down of the opponent by continued cost, rather than by one decisive stroke.
war_attrition.example: Attrition decided the campaign; no single battle did.
